judgment.notes: This is a total extended-nonnegative infimum for arbitrary subsets of a metric space, p>0 and finite δ>0. Bounded member sets give genuine finite real diameters, preventing toReal(∞)=0 from admitting unbounded covers. The pairwise-distance condition is equivalent to the diameter cutoff; empty members have zero cost, finite covers are padded, and absent admissible covers give ∞. It exactly preserves problem.md:34–43's countable covers, ≤ cutoff and unnormalized diameter powers, with no measurability restriction or hidden existence hypothesis. Agreement with native content is exported as N001, not assumed by this definition.

The supremum over all finite positive real scales of D018 is well-defined in [0,∞] for each arbitrary subset and p>0. It preserves the original positive-exponent measure formula, empty-member convention and absence of a dimensional factor. It imposes no measurability or compactness assumption and grants no critical-exponent theorem or native-measure equality; that correspondence is an internal N001 obligation.
